subject: ELA Curriculum Review
overview: The Curriculum Subcommittee met to review the Medford Public Schools English Language Arts (ELA) curriculum and proposed next steps. District leadership outlined current literacy resources, professional development efforts, budget needs, and plans to pilot a new elementary reading program.

items.title: ELA Curriculum Presentation and Review
items.summary: Humanities Director Dr. Nicole Chiesa presented an overview of the district's English Language Arts curriculum, detailing instructional resources, equity initiatives, program budget costs, and a multi-year timeline to pilot and select a new core reading program.
